decision: Reviewed master myself. No GitHub review comments and no issues. Draft PR 6 left untouched.
why: The ask was to apply existing reviews or review the code and fix real bugs on a new branch.
evidence: gh pr list and gh api pulls/comments empty

decision: Store the last Gmail history record id when a page has nextPageToken, and chain another sync.
why: The response historyId is the mailbox tip. Saving it after one page skips every later page.
evidence: tests/sync-bugs.test.ts historyCursor; old script stored TIP

decision: Sync any Gmail mailbox whose lastSyncedAt is older than 60s, including error.
why: syncNow skipped status error, so one failure stopped mail until reconnect. Comment review asked for the same cooldown.

decision: Merge gmailLabelIds inside the patch mutation and send only the new key.
why: Two actions each wrote a full map, so the later write dropped the other category.

decision: Put base64 padding back on reply subjects and bodies.
why: utf8Base64 stripped equals signs. A strict parser rejects that. Gmail raw send still uses unpadded base64url.
evidence: tests/sync-bugs.test.ts buildMime; old encoder emitted SGk

decision: Saturday morning This weekend stays today at 9:00. Share SNOOZE_MIN_MS with the server check.
why: Offset 0 was forced to 7. The one-minute floor lived in two places.
evidence: tests/sync-bugs.test.ts weekendMorning; old date Sat Oct 24 2026

decision: Say 30 days on the connect banner, clear the newest backfill runs, and show a route error when a message query throws.
why: The banner said 7 while the query is newer_than:30d. The clear query was oldest-first. useQuery throws with no errorComponent.
evidence: vite build strings in dist settings and message chunks

decision: pnpm tsc, convex tsc, eslint, node tests, and vite build.
why: Prove the pure decisions and that the app still compiles. Did not run convex dev --once because that deploys.

decision: Follow nextPageToken until a history record id shows up, then stop.
why: A page with a token and no record id left the cursor unchanged, so later pages never loaded. Trail review flagged that stall.

decision: The cooldown came from comment review of this diff, not from a GitHub review.
why: The sync row said a comment review asked for it. GitHub had no review comments. Comment-sicko flagged an immediate retry.

decision: Re-ran eslint on the sync files, the node test, app tsc, and convex tsc after the page-token follow.
why: The earlier verify row named those commands but pointed only at the test file.
evidence: node tests/sync-bugs.test.ts printed sync bugs ok; tsc and eslint exited 0

decision: Triage writes category and odds only when userMoved is set. Status, route, and snooze set the flag. Re-sort clears it.
why: Info and spam drags stayed in inbox or lost their route, so saveTriage replaced the column. status !== inbox still wrote route.

decision: Skip a Gmail messages.get 404 and keep going. Rethrow anything else so the history cursor stays.
why: One 404 threw before historyId advanced, so the same page retried and later ids never arrived.

decision: Connect backfill no longer passes a 2000 limit.
why: start stored the profile historyId and stopped the 30-day query at 2000, so older mail in that window never returned. backfill.start already pages until the query ends.

decision: A domain row for the same address becomes provider gmail and stores historyId. An existing Gmail row keeps its cursor.
why: upsertGmail only cleared the error, so sync returned immediately for provider domain. Replacing a Gmail historyId would skip the gap.

decision: read returns replyTo and the reader shows it when it differs from From. Send still uses replyTo or from.
why: The reader showed only From, so a different Reply-To looked like the reply would go to the sender.

decision: The empty history page finding was already fixed by following pageToken inside historySince. Unverified domain signup stays.
why: The review described a single-page history fetch. That loop already follows an empty page. Domain proof is a new verification flow.

decision: Re-ran eslint on the edited files, app tsc, convex tsc, and the node test.
why: Prove the new pure decisions and that the app still compiles. Did not deploy and did not open a signed-in reader.
evidence: node tests/sync-bugs.test.ts printed sync bugs ok

decision: Merged origin/master, which includes PRs 6 through 11, into this branch.
why: The branch started before filters, review findings, pause/retry, the filters table, workflow suggestions, and stable layouts.

decision: Dropped a second triage-failure writer and its reader copy.
why: Master already sets triageFailed, routes the email to action, and explains that in the reader. onTriageDone is wired from startTriage.

decision: Kept history paging, userMoved, the 404 skip, the uncapped 30-day backfill, Reply-To, the spam column, the OAuth allowlist, domain takeover, and the per-run backfill pill.
why: Those bugs are still in the merged master. Master sync stores body.historyId, saveTriage still overwrites an inbox route, and the spam filter is still true.
